title: Keep the catalog usable during a Shipping outage
scenario: A team of technicians found that the shipping service is sometimes unavailable. They are currently investigation the cause of the outage. For now, management wants a quick fix until the main cause is solved.
why: Customers have already reported missing shipping information in tge last weeks. Customers need a usable delivery option to plan their purchase. Otherwise they cant buy the products, which would lead to a monetary loss. .
reproduce: Disconnect Primary Shipping in Network Faults. Compare availability and delivery previews before and after applying a mitigation. You should not solve the cause but try to handle it better in case of future service unavailability.
assignment: Can you restore delivery information during a primary Shipping outage?

fields.label: Healthy baseline and metric
fields.prompt: Record your baseline. Include all the data you identify as relevant from Grafana into your notes. Watch healthy availability and delivery carefully.

fields.label: Hypothesis and fault injection
fields.prompt: What could be the impact of an unavailable shipping service? Which functions will fail? Record your hypothesis and disconnect the shipping service.

fields.label: Fault evidence
fields.prompt: Investigate delivery information for all products. Record status, queue size and new rejections.

fields.label: Mitigation and reason
fields.prompt: What did you configure, and how does it restore a usable delivery option? Distinguish fallback, timeout and breaker.

fields.label: Same-outage validation
fields.prompt: Compare the identical fault after mitigation was introduced. Measure the impact on Storefront and in Grafana and explain what happens.

fields.label: Blast-radius conclusion and cleanup
fields.prompt: What did the customer regain, what trade-off remains? If you reconnect shipping, what happens?

solution: The primary outage makes delivery requests fail while stock services remain healthy.
Shipping fallback calls a separate carrier and returns real quotes for all three products: €4.90 and 5 days, compared with €4.90 and 3 days normally.
The breaker can pause primary calls for five seconds while backup quotes continue.^^.
Reconnect Primary Shipping, and refresh to verify normal delivery estimates return.
